verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud hosting platform, so storage auto-growth and usage-based storage billing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents volume auto-growth or byte-based storage billing. The only nearby items are mentions of a 'persistent disk' for cloud agents and a user praising hard spending limits; both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know attached disk/storage auto-grows with usage and I'm billed only for bytes actually written rather than pre-provisioned capacity
